## Purpose and entry points
Gentle-AI is a Go CLI that configures already-installed AI coding runtimes with managed prompts, SDD workflows, skills, model settings, persistent-memory wiring, and optional Receipt-Driven Development (RDD) review. Primary executable entry point: `cmd/gentle-ai/main.go`; application command composition and version/update behavior live in `internal/app/app.go` and `internal/cli/run.go`. It offers both command-line and interactive TUI entry paths (`internal/tui/router.go`).

## Runtime discovery and integration boundary
Agent support is adapter-based: common discovery, registry, factory, and capability abstractions select an installed runtime without installing it. See `internal/agents/interface.go`, `internal/agents/factory.go`, and representative adapters such as `internal/agents/claude/adapter.go`, `internal/agents/opencode/adapter.go`, and `internal/agents/pi/adapter.go`. Adapters define each runtime’s configuration paths and supported capabilities; deployment logic should remain runtime-neutral above this boundary.

## Installation, planning, and managed deployment
`install`, `sync`, and related commands turn chosen components/presets into an installation plan, then apply file mutations with backups and rollback support. The pipeline separates orchestration, ordered stages, execution, and rollback in `internal/pipeline/orchestrator.go`, `internal/pipeline/stages.go`, and `internal/pipeline/rollback.go`. Dependency ordering is modeled independently in `internal/planner/graph.go`, `internal/planner/order.go`, and `internal/planner/resolver.go`. Safe config edits and transactional recovery are centralized in `internal/components/filemerge/writer.go`, `internal/components/mutationjournal/journal.go`, and `internal/backup/snapshot.go`.

## Bundled assets and feature injectors
Embedded assets are the product payload: agent-specific instructions, commands, subagents, skills, personas, and OpenCode plugins under `internal/assets/`. Feature components render and inject those payloads into adapter-owned destinations, notably SDD (`internal/components/sdd/inject.go`, `internal/components/sdd/orchestrator.go`), skills (`internal/components/skills/inject.go`), and persona (`internal/components/persona/inject.go`). SDD supports durable project workflows and renderer/profile variants; its source assets include `internal/assets/skills/sdd-apply/SKILL.md` and `internal/assets/opencode/sdd-orchestrator.md`.

## Persistent memory and external integrations
Engram is an externally supplied memory runtime that Gentle-AI installs/configures, health-checks, and injects into compatible agent configurations rather than implementing memory itself. Its integration boundary is `internal/components/engram/setup.go`, `internal/components/engram/inject.go`, and `internal/components/engram/healthprobe.go`. MCP configuration is separately injected through `internal/components/mcp/inject.go` with a Context7 integration in `internal/components/mcp/context7.go`. OpenCode plugin ownership/install behavior is isolated in `internal/components/opencodeplugin/plugin.go`.

## RDD review lifecycle
Optional native review is a stateful, Git-backed transaction system, distinct from ordinary delivery decisions. CLI review verbs are a façade over lifecycle operations in `internal/cli/review_facade.go`, `internal/cli/review_start_contract.go`, and `internal/cli/review_repair.go`. The domain layer freezes candidate scope/snapshots, maintains a locked receipt/ledger store, classifies authority, admits reviewer artifacts, and controls recovery: `internal/reviewtransaction/transaction.go`, `internal/reviewtransaction/store.go`, `internal/reviewtransaction/snapshot.go`, `internal/reviewtransaction/ledger.go`, and `internal/reviewtransaction/gate.go`. Published provider-facing JSON schemas form a compatibility boundary in `contracts/review-integration/v2/schemas/`.

## SDD state, providers, and platform/release concerns
SDD command state and review-gate consumption are modeled separately from review transactions in `internal/sddstatus/status.go`, `internal/sddstatus/runtime_ledger.go`, and `internal/cli/sdd_attempt.go`. External review-agent invocation is adapterized in `internal/reviewerprovider/contract.go` and runtime-specific adapters such as `internal/reviewerprovider/claude_adapter.go`. The application targets macOS, Linux, and Windows, with platform-specific process/file implementations throughout review and storage code. It relies on Git, detected agent binaries, Node/npm for install flows, GitHub releases for updates, and Minisign-verified release artifacts via `internal/update/upgrade/download.go` and `internal/update/upgrade/executor.go`.
